title: The Orbit of Sector Nine
author: Cyrus Montrose
blurb: Casper Montrose, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
